purpose: Evidence-backed texture hints; never a whitelist for deleting source pitches or voices.

hkco-range-2012.title: HKCO orchestral range/template chart
hkco-range-2012.locator: Bangdi/Qudi/Xindi, sheng and suona I/II; Erhu I/II
hkco-range-2012.supports: Examples of separate orchestral parts, not a rule that all scores have two voices.

hkco-range-2025.title: HKCO Instrumentation and Range Table 2025
hkco-range-2025.locator: Instrument list, player counts, plucked-string notes
hkco-range-2025.supports: Orchestral instruments and notation conventions; player count does not establish voice count.

hkco-plucked.title: HKCO Plucked-string Instruments
hkco-plucked.supports: Plucked and struck-string distinction, common orchestral instrumentation.

hkco-ensembles.title: HKCO Plucked-String Notes
hkco-ensembles.supports: Pipa quartet, ruan quartet and yangqin duet are real independent-player ensemble examples, not proof of a specific orchestral divisi passage.

sheng-qi.title: Samuel Wong Shengmiao, QI: Sheng chapter (2005), hosted by Atlas Ensemble
sheng-qi.supports: Sheng chords, counterpoint and instrument-model-dependent playability.

vico-erhu.title: Vancouver Inter-Cultural Orchestra: Erhu
vico-erhu.supports: Double stops require performer consultation; bowing and left-hand pizzicato can coexist, so unusual independent layers must remain possible.

guzheng-lcsd.locator: I-1 two-hand arpeggios; A-2 harmony and polyphony exercises

liuqin-lcsd.title: LCSD Music Office: Liuqin syllabus (2019 revision)

liuqin-lcsd.supports: Direct instrument-specific teaching evidence for multi-pitch gestures; does not establish arbitrary independent counterpoint.

liuqin-wang.title: Wang Huiran: 乐改 创作 演奏 教学——柳琴艺术发展之四统一
liuqin-wang.supports: First-person account of liuqin chords, sweeps and ensemble development.

yangqin-nacyo.title: North America Chinese Youth Orchestra: Yangqin
yangqin-nacyo.supports: Yangqin orchestral polyphonic support, chords and arpeggios.

vico-sanxian.title: VICO Instrument Corner
vico-sanxian.supports: Three-string structure and performance context; specific chord/counterpoint capability remains a score-dependent review item.

mx-voice.title: MusicXML voice

mx-arpeggiate.title: MusicXML arpeggiate

profiles.note: 通常单人单音；分组 I/II 是乐团层级，特殊复音另核。
曲笛I/II 表示独立声部，不把同时出现的两个声部合成单人和弦。
此处仅共用织体提示；新笛和大笛并非同一种结构，不共用移调、指法或音域参数。
通常单人旋律；多名演奏者或特殊复音按原谱确认，不设绝对禁令。
音区品种和 I/II 分组分别记录；普通单音、特殊复音不能互相推断。
通常按单人旋律；大谱表或低音谱号不等于已经识别出两个独立声部。
可含和音与复调，但具体管数、排列和指法约束不同，不能保证任意和弦可奏。
同时保留单人和弦、单人复调、乐团独立笙部的可能性；具体型号另行确认。
不照搬小提琴常规双音；高胡独有多音技法须另核，乐团分组按原谱。
二胡I/II、divisi 与单人特殊双音分开；弓奏与左手拨弦可并行，需核对原谱及演奏者；泛音触点不自动当和弦。
通常单线旋律；家族推断只是保守提示，不声称与二胡技法完全一致。
和弦、扫拂、琶音可在一个事件流内；旋律/低音独立时保留多声部；多人琵琶分组另记。
保留双音、和弦、扫拂和轮奏；不因此把所有音列都拆为两条旋律。
和音、三和弦及分解和弦有教材依据；多声部或多名演奏者按原谱区分。
多音能力为阮族层级保守推断；不直接移用中阮具体和弦、定弦或指法。
已确认三弦结构与乐团配置；双音、扫弦及复调的细项待对应教材/分谱核实，原多音照实保留。
撮、双手琶音、和音与复调都需保留；左右手不是两名演奏者，声部里还可包含和弦。
击弦；双手、旋律/伴奏和复调可形成独立流，每流仍可能含和音；扬琴重奏另属多人关系。
